description: "Criticisms on 'The Origin of Species' by Thomas Henry Huxley" is a scientific publication written in the mid-19th century, likely during the Victorian era. The book serves as a critique of Charles Darwin's groundbreaking work "The Origin of Species," focusing specifically on the validity and implications of Darwin's theories on evolution and natural selection.
